Live Canvas Agent Protocol
|-- Tool requests -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|   |-- Bind the target
|   |   |-- canvas.list() -> registered browser workspaces and documents
|   |   |-- canvas.attach(canvasId, documentId) -> sessionId + current version
|   |   |   `-- Session retains canvasId, documentId and optional changeSessionId
|   |   `-- callBound(token) captures the chat target and lazily attaches
|   |       `-- Conflicting explicit session -> CHAT_BINDING_MISMATCH
|   |-- Validate before execution
|   |   |-- contracts.ts schemas validate tool arguments and canvas methods
|   |   |-- Read-only access restricts tools and individual exec methods
|   |   `-- Mutations require version guards; context changes also pin revisionId
|   |-- Route by attachment
|   |   |-- Live document -> CanvasSessionPort -> owning browser
|   |   |-- Proposal document -> ChangeSessionService snapshot/apply
|   |   |   |-- Attachment and changeSessionId must match
|   |   |   `-- save_diagram cannot publish proposal revisions
|   |   `-- Diagram generation -> edit/batch services -> bound browser commands
|   `-- Retain request identity
|       |-- Scope: access mode + change session + tool + session + requestId
|       |-- Same key and arguments -> reuse pending/completed promise
|       |-- Same key with different arguments -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|       `-- Timeout or rejected/oversized reply -> release request cache entry
|           `-- Retry identical requestId; browser outcome may already be committed
|-- exec(code) -> bounded runtime with replayable API steps
|   |-- QuickJsAgentRuntime exposes frozen canvas, nodes and edges APIs
|   |   |-- 32 MiB memory; 512 KiB stack; 30-second deadline
|   |   `-- Interrupt budget; at most 100 API calls; 4 MiB result limits
|   |-- Capture initial document version and record each method/argument signature
|   |   `-- Mutations require expectedVersion to match the initial version
|   |-- Batched mode [default]
|   |   |-- Consecutive mutations -> queued operations + provisional IDs
|   |   |-- Reads, canvas calls and certain metadata writes flush pending edits
|   |   `-- Final flush -> compact mutation receipts + resulting version
|   |-- Immediate mode
|   |   `-- Each mutation -> apply -> advance version -> return projected result
|   `-- Ambiguous transport failure -> retain execution state
|       |-- Retry replays completed step results
|       |-- Resend unacknowledged work with retained IDs and expected version
|       |-- Changed step or batch sequence -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|       `-- Unacknowledged steps prevent a successful completion response
|-- Command transport -> CanvasSessionBridge -> useAgentCanvasBridge
|   |-- Browser registers ephemeral canvasId, stableWorkspaceId and documents
|   |-- Backend dispatch assigns command ID and queues document-bound payload
|   |   |-- At most 100 pending commands
|   |   `-- Wake browser long poll; idle poll waits up to 15 seconds
|   |-- Browser processes commands sequentially through its current handler
|   |   |-- Retain up to 200 mutation results keyed by command ID
|   |   `-- Encode reply -> POST value/error with command ID
|   |       `-- Rejected reply -> report CANVAS_REPLY_REJECTED to backend
|   |-- Backend matches canvasId + command ID -> resolve/reject waiting dispatch
|   |   `-- After 25 seconds -> CANVAS_TIMEOUT; outcome may be unknown
|   `-- Lifetime
|       |-- Browser refreshes registration after polling; failure retries after 1 second
|       |-- Bridge list() retires registrations untouched for over 35 seconds
|       `-- Page hide/unmount -> unregister; pending commands fail CANVAS_UNAVAILABLE
|-- Reads -> compact data with explicit reference lifetimes
|   |-- currentCanvasRead(level, nodeIds)
|   |   |-- small -> text, structure, complete selected-diagram evidence/mappings,
|   |   |           collapse state, highlights and jumps with active/stale status
|   |   |-- full -> also geometry, other display objects, edges and canvas view
|   |   `-- Current state only; small reads avoid constructing layout and history
|   |-- CanvasReadAliases for canvas.read()
|   |   |-- Immutable per-read aliases -> original IDs
|   |   |-- Bound to canvas + document + optional change session
|   |   |-- 30-minute expiry; retain at most 128 reads and 50,000 IDs per read
|   |   `-- Expired/unknown alias -> STALE_READ; wrong target -> READ_BINDING_MISMATCH
|   `-- CanvasApiProjection for node APIs and live context
|       |-- ASCII/structure in content; diagram metadata omits duplicate content
|       |-- Opaque anchor handles retain full revision/hash-scoped identity
|       |-- Shared tool/socket handle vocabulary; domain state keeps full IDs
|       `-- Handles never reassigned; unknown handle -> STALE_CONTENT_NODE
|           `-- Backend restart requires rereading handles
|-- Live selection channel -> publishLiveCanvasSelections -> LiveCanvasService
|   |-- One protocol-v2 publisher socket per browser workspace
|   |   `-- Observe each visible draft with its own canvasEpoch and sequence
|   |-- observeCanvasSelection samples completed selection state
|   |   |-- Whole-diagram IDs + regions containing rectangle, text and source IDs
|   |   |-- Changed source text/content binding -> region marked stale
|   |   `-- Coalesce controller notifications; unchanged selection emits nothing
|   |-- Publish bounded updates
|   |   |-- First send or reconnect -> current selection.snapshot
|   |   |-- Same epoch -> selection.delta against last transmitted snapshot
|   |   |   `-- baseSequence + upserted regions + removed IDs + changed diagram IDs
|   |   |-- Coalesce pending state; pause drain above 64 KiB socket buffer
|   |   `-- Hidden/removed/replaced draft -> remove old epoch; dispose observer
|   |-- Service owns publisher identity and validates incoming state
|   |   |-- Old sequence in same epoch -> ignore
|   |   |-- Delta requires matching epoch and baseSequence -> otherwise out of sync
|   |   `-- Enforce unique IDs, region/diagram limits and total region-text limit
|   |-- Agent attach(workspaceInstanceId, documentId)
|   |   |-- Requires published selection -> connectionId bound to canvasEpoch
|   |   |-- Initial bound selection -> later deltas fan out to matching connections
|   |   `-- agents.changed reports active binding count to publisher
|   `-- Identity changes invalidate bindings
|       |-- New document epoch -> canvas.replaced
|       |-- Document removal -> canvas.closed
|       |-- Publisher disconnect -> canvas.disconnected
|       `-- Reject pending copy/paste; old connections must rediscover and attach
|-- Live context and scoped agent context
|   |-- context.get -> load browser context -> CanvasApiProjection
|   |   `-- Recheck publisher, epoch and binding after await; reject replaced state
|   |-- agent-context.upload -> AgentContextService with current live binding
|   |-- Diagram edit/batch context resolution uses workspace + document scope
|   `-- diagram-agent-context
|       |-- read -> absent, ready or stale according to source fingerprint
|       `-- prepare/delete -> check document version + diagram revision
|           `-- Retain exact mutation payload for retry -> apply-diagram-context
`-- Live copy/paste commands also use the publisher socket
    |-- diagram.copy -> normalize ASCII -> stage ephemeral text in browser
    |   `-- Requires advertised diagram.copy capability; user chooses paste position
    |-- diagram.paste -> normalize ASCII -> command with stable nodeId,
    |                   documentId, canvasEpoch, expectedVersion and position
    |   `-- Successful reply must match nodeId and expectedVersion + 1
    `-- Receipt scope: workspace + document + epoch + requestId
        |-- Changed arguments -> REQUEST_ID_REUSED
        |-- Pending duplicate -> share promise; completed duplicate -> reuse result
        |-- 25-second timeout -> retry identical arguments with retained command
        `-- Never evict receipts into possible duplicate insertion
            `-- Each operation has a 2,000-receipt cap and 100-pending cap
